name: vegetable ragu
instructions:
TWO VEGETABLE-FORWARD RAGUS under one roof. Both are pasta ragus but neither is a bolognese — mushrooms + eggplant (variant A) or mushrooms + lentils (variant B) carry the protein slot. See notes for how these differ from the bolognese family (master-bolognese.json).

=== VARIANT A — EGGPLANT RAGU (VEGAN) ===

- Sauté finely diced yellow onions and shallots in olive oil with garlic.
- Add diced eggplant and portabella mushrooms; cook down until soft and browned.
- Add ground vegan meat, break it up, cook through.
- Stir in canned tomatoes, porcini mushroom powder, nutritional yeast, red wine vinegar. Simmer until thickened.
- Toss with pasta.

=== VARIANT B — MUSHROOM LENTIL RAGU (VEGETARIAN) ===

- Brown mushrooms HARD in olive oil — get real color on them. Set aside.
- Sauté yellow onions in the same pan. Deglaze with red wine; reduce.
- Add lentils, canned tomatoes, and enough water to cover the lentils. Simmer until lentils are tender.
- Return mushrooms to the pan; warm through.
- Finish OFF HEAT with parmesan, nutritional yeast, basil, and parsley. Salt and black pepper to taste.
- Toss with pasta.
notes:
=== NOT BOLOGNESE — SEPARATE FAMILY ===

These two variants used to live in the same file as the bolognese variants (now master-bolognese.json). They were split out because they aren't bolognese-shaped: neither uses milk-before-wine, neither runs on the 3-hour uncovered simmer, and the protein slot is entirely vegetable (mushroom + eggplant, or mushroom + lentil). See master-bolognese.json for the bolognese family (Marcella, Nisha, ATK, my mix).

=== SHARED SHAPE ACROSS BOTH VARIANTS ===
1. Tomato base (canned tomatoes; regular, NOT fire-roasted — that's the meatball recipe's signature).
2. Vegetable protein slot: mushroom + eggplant + ground vegan meat (A); mushroom + lentil (B).
3. Acid: red wine vinegar (A); red wine (B). Don't mix or swap.
4. Soffrito-style aromatics: yellow onion always in; shallots/celery/carrot/garlic vary.
5. Served over pasta. Penne / rigatoni / other short shapes work fine — long-cut isn't required here.

=== FAUX MEAT (VARIANT A) ===

Ground vegan meat is the canonical choice for variant A. Impossible also works but is overkill — the eggplant + mushroom already carry the meat-analog work, so a very meaty faux meat competes rather than blends.

=== NO FIRE-ROASTED TOMATOES ===

Regular canned tomatoes for both variants. Fire-roasted is the signature of the separate fire-roasted-meatballs recipe — using them here reads too smoky against the mushroom + eggplant or mushroom + lentil register.

=== HERB FINISH — VARIANT B ONLY ===

Variant B (mushroom lentil) wants basil and parsley off heat — the wine-and-lentil base is brightened by fresh herb finishes. Variant A (eggplant) does NOT take fresh herb finishes well — the porcini powder and nutritional yeast do the umami work and fresh herbs read as a distraction against the eggplant + mushroom base.

=== DISTINCTION FROM LENTIL-MUSHROOM-STEW ===

Variant B has overlapping headline ingredients with lentil-mushroom-potato-stew (mushrooms, lentils, tomato). Different dish: the stew is broth-forward, served as a soup, explicitly anti-canned-tomato and anti-tomato-paste, uses stock not pasta. Don't merge.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- master-bolognese.json: the bolognese family (Marcella, Nisha, ATK, my mix). Related shape but structurally distinct (milk before wine, 3-hour simmer for the canonical Marcella).
- fire-roasted-meatballs.json: split off from the same master, uses fire-roasted tomatoes + meatball shape.
- master-italian-tomato-sauce-and-pesto.json: the protein-free pasta-sauce side of the italian pasta family.
